purpose: Machine-readable interface design rules bound to the canonical capability interface ledger and schema registry.

rules.description: cross-boundary interfaces are versioned through schema/compatibility registry before incompatible change
provider/framework implementation types do not become canonical contract identities
cancellation/unknown outcomes are explicit where operation semantics admit side effects
